whatIs: blobatar generates geometric avatars from any text: the same text always produces the same avatar, so it works as a default profile image without storing anything. It has no dependencies and weighs about 4.4 KB compressed.
It's a good fit when you need unique, consistent avatars for users without a photo. There's a React component and an editor to adjust each trait.
uses: Showing a default avatar in a user list using their name or email as the seed.
Giving a blog's comments a visual identity without requiring sign-up.
Animating the avatar on hover with animate="hover" on the Blobatar component.
caveats: If you use the email as the seed, the avatar is tied to that data: think about whether you want to expose it.
Without the animate prop, the component renders as a plain image; animations have to be turned on and require importing the motion CSS.
The official component is for React; in other environments you'll have to use the base package.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Apps with users who have no photo and need unique, stable avatars.
